text: 【A股新经济公司数量、营收、市值占比均超一半】中国证监会主席吴清在首届中国资本市场学术年会开幕式上表示，目前，A股5500多家上市公司中，新经济领域公司数量、营收、市值在全市场占比均超过一半。证监会14日披露了相关信息。吴清表示，中国资本市场始终与中国经济改革同频共振，与实体经济发展共生共荣，在探索创新中不断成长壮大，逐步发展成为与中国经济体量大致匹配、具有全球影响力的重要市场。
text_en: [Number, revenue and market capitalization of new-economy companies in A-shares all exceed half] CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the opening ceremony of the first China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that among the more than 5,500 listed companies in the A-share market, new-economy companies account for more than half of the whole market in terms of number, revenue and market capitalization. The CSRC disclosed the relevant information on the 14th. Wu Qing said that China's capital market has always resonated with China's economic reform and grown together with the real economy, continuously growing and expanding through exploration and innovation, and has gradually developed into an important market with global influence that roughly matches the size of China's economy.
